methodologyNotes: Covers vehicle rooftop tents (RTTs) that mount to a roof rack or crossbars and are sold at a published US MSRP. Includes soft-shell fold-out and hard-shell pop-up/clamshell designs; excludes ground tents, truck-bed-only tents, and awnings. Price is typical US retail / MSRP in USD for the base tent (annex and accessories priced separately unless noted). shellType is an enum: soft-shell, hard-shell, or hybrid. sleepingCapacity is the manufacturer-rated number of adults (integer). closedHeightIn is the packed profile height on the roof in inches (lower is more aerodynamic). mountedFootprintIn is the closed length x width on the rack in inches. sleepingAreaIn is the deployed interior floor length x width in inches. peakInteriorHeightIn is the maximum standing/sitting headroom inside when open, in inches. mattressThicknessIn is the included foam mattress thickness in inches. weightLbs is the tent's own shipping/mounted weight in pounds (excludes rack). staticLoadCapacityLbs is the manufacturer-rated maximum occupant load the deployed tent supports in pounds; null if not disclosed. canopyFabric is an enum describing the primary tent-body textile: poly-cotton, polyester-ripstop, nylon-ripstop, or polyester. annexIncluded is a boolean for whether a full-height room/annex ships in the box.

products.name: Roofnest Falcon 3 EVO
products.priceNote: US retailer Off Road Alliance lists the Roofnest Falcon 3 EVO (SKU FAL3-TNT-REG) at "$3,795.00" (MSRP/Now price, no discount). The GearJunkie hands-on review (June 2024) cites the original launch price as "($3,495)"; used the current retailer figure of $3,795 as the typical US retail price for the standalone base tent.
products.provenance: Off Road Alliance's product page (SKU FAL3-TNT-REG, "Roofnest Falcon 3 EVO Rooftop Tent") confirms the EXACT standalone model — clamshell, Sleeps 2, PC/ABS with LINE-X shell, 320 GSM coated Polycotton, integrated 2" memory-foam mattress, Weight 140 lbs, Exterior 83 x 50", Interior 80 x 47", Max Headroom 58" open, 8" when closed — and lists the price verbatim as $3,795.00; its Related Products list the EVO Air / EVO XL / EVO XL Air as separate items, ruling out variant confusion. The GearJunkie review (dated June 18, 2024) independently corroborates the 140 lb weight, 83 x 50 closed footprint, 80 x 47 sleeping footprint, 58" peak internal height and 8" closed height, and is the sole source for the 650 lb Static weight capacity (it also notes the original $3,495 launch price). Roofnest's own site no longer hosts a standalone Falcon 3 EVO page — the falcon-3-evo URL now redirects to the distinct, lighter EVO Air (130 lbs / 280 GSM / no Line-X / self-inflating mattress) — so this retailer listing plus the dated hands-on review are the authoritative real pages for this exact discontinued model.

products.name: iKamper Skycamp 3.0
products.priceNote: US MSRP for the base tent. iKamper.com lists the Skycamp 3.0 (Rocky Black Shell) at a regular/old price of $4,895.00, currently discounted to a sale price of $3,425.00. Authorized dealer Off Road Alliance corroborates an MSRP of $4,595.00–$4,895.00 depending on shell color (Black vs Rocky Black). Using $4,895.00 as the full list MSRP, which appears verbatim on both the manufacturer and dealer pages.
products.provenance: The iKamper.com product page confirms this is the exact Skycamp 3.0 hard-shell (FRP) roof top tent and lists its full spec table: weight 165 lbs, sleeping area 82 3/4" x 77 1/4", height 13 1/2" closed / 48" open, closed footprint 85 1/2" x 54 3/4", 9-zone 2 1/2" insulated polyfoam mattress, and 300gsm poly-cotton blackout canvas body; it shows a regular/old price of $4,895.00 (on sale for $3,425.00) and a FAQ stating the tents hold about 900 lbs. Off Road Alliance (authorized dealer) corroborates the same Skycamp 3.0 with decimal specs (13.5"/48", 85.5" x 54.75", 82.75" x 77.25", 2.5" mattress, 165 lbs, 300gsm poly-cotton) and an MSRP range of $4,595.00–$4,895.00, and dates the 3.0 series to 2022. Both pages list the annex (Annex Plus) as a separately sold accessory not included in the box, so annexIncluded is false; peakInteriorHeightIn is left null because the 48" figure is stated as overall open/peak height rather than explicitly interior headroom.

products.name: Thule Approach M

The Rackstarz retailer page for the same model (901039) lists $2,999.95; the manufacturer MSRP was used per methodology (typical US retail / MSRP for the base tent).

Every spec value was taken verbatim from that page: sleeping capacity "3 person", closed dimensions "49 x 56 x 11 in", sleeping footprint "95 x 51 in", peak internal height "40.2 in", weight "128 lb", static weight capacity "660 lb", "600D polyester ripstop" canopy, and "soft-shell" construction (annex is sold separately). The Rackstarz retailer page independently confirms the exact model (901039, Pelican gray, 2-3 person) but shows a higher retailer price of $2,999.95, so the $2,699.95 manufacturer MSRP was used; mattress thickness is not numerically disclosed on either page and is left null.

products.name: Smittybilt GEN2 Overlander

products.provenance: The official Smittybilt product page (Part #2583, Gen2 Overlander Standard, Gray) confirms this exact model with an MSRP of $1,499.99 and states the closed size (47"W x 55"L x 11.5"H), open size (95"W x 56"L x 51"H), Full 92"x55" bed, "Max load rating 660lbs/300kg", and "600d heavy-duty rip stop polyester" body. The Off Road Tents retailer page corroborates the same SKU 2583 at $1,497.00, explicitly calls it a "softshell roof top tent" rated for "three adults," and shows the annex is a separate $320 add-on (not included in the base tent). Both pages agree on the load rating, fabric, and bed/open dimensions, confirming model identity; neither page lists a mattress thickness or tent weight, so those are left null.

products.provenance: The Yakima manufacturer page titled "SkyRise HD Medium (2020 - 2025)" (SKU #8007437, UPC 736745074371) confirms this exact Medium model and states verbatim: 600D Ripstop Polyester body, 2.5" foam mattress, Open Dimensions 56" x 96" x 48" High, closed Dimensions L 58 in x W 48 in x H 17 in, and Weight 114.64 lbs; it is archived and lists no price.
